<div class="course-registration-switch" data-opening="2027-02-01" data-closing="2027-04-15">

<div data-registration-state="before">

<div class="course-registration">

<div class="course-registration-content">

<div class="course-registration-title">
Registration opens soon
</div>

<div class="course-registration-message">
Registration for this training opens on 1 February 2027.
</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div data-registration-state="open" hidden>

<div class="course-registration">

<div class="course-registration-content">

<div class="course-registration-title">
Registration is open
</div>

<div class="course-registration-deadline">Register by 15 April 2027.</div>
<div class="course-registration-fee">Cost: 2500 SEK</div>
<div class="course-registration-note">Free for PhD students at Swedish universities. Lunch and coffee are included.
</div>

</div>

<a
    class="course-registration-button"
    href="https://example.org/register/introduction-to-r">
    Register for this training →
</a>

</div>

</div>

<div data-registration-state="closed" hidden>

<div class="course-registration">

<div class="course-registration-content">

<div class="course-registration-title">
Registration is closed
</div>

<div class="course-registration-message">
Registration for this training is now closed.
</div>

<div class="course-registration-note">
For questions or more information, please contact the training team.
</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var banner = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  if (!banner || !banner.dataset.opening) {
    return;
  }

  var now = new Date();
  var today = [
    now.getFullYear(),
    String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
    String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
  ].join("-");

  var opening = banner.dataset.opening;
  var closing = banner.dataset.closing;
  var state =
    today < opening ? "before" :
    (!closing || today <= closing) ? "open" :
    "closed";

  banner.querySelectorAll("[data-registration-state]").forEach(function (part) {
    part.hidden = part.dataset.registrationState !== state;
  });
})();
</script>
